main_text.l: Operâ & Studio Caroli Mariæ de Veil,
Zephirinus Papa Epist. 1. ad Episcopos Sicilienses apud Grat. dist. 38.
Sicut stellæ Cæli non extinguunt noctem, sic mentes fidelium & inhærentes firmamento S. Scripturæ non obscurat mundana iniquitas.
Excudebat Sam. Roycroft LL. Orientalium Typographus Regius, & prostant Venales apud Robertum Littlebury sub Insignibus Anglicè dictis Kings Arms in Vico vulgò vocato Fleet-Street [?] 1678.

page.notes: Manuscript annotations ("2.40.8", "5.11.68" struck through) and the library stamp "BIBL. CANT. ACAD." are not printed text and are omitted. Mirrored show-through of "IMPRIMATUR", "Sacris Domestic." and "Joan. 5. v. 39." from the reverse is omitted; the line "Martii 29. 1678." and "Joan. 5. v. 39." are only partly legible, so the date and the Joan. reference are not transcribed. The street name in the imprint and the line "Sicut stellæ..." are blurred and uncertain.
